name: munit-message123
description: The IT's Message123 on queue 'in' is rolled back on deliveries 1-4 (MyException) and published unchanged to topic1 on delivery 5 (JMSXDeliveryCount==5). Redeliveries follow the RedeliveryPolicy bean: 5000 ms before the first, 2000 ms between the others. Nothing is left on 'in' or dead-lettered.

source.reference: jms-message-rollback-and-redelivery/src/test/java/org/mule/examples/JmsMessageRollbackAndRedeliveryIT.java (dispatch Message123 to jms://queue:in; topic1 payload equals Message123 within 30 s); src/main/app/jms-redelivery.xml (choice JMSXDeliveryCount==5, rollback-exception-strategy for MyException, redeliveryPolicy initialRedeliveryDelay=5000 redeliveryDelay=2000); README.md ('After ... unsuccessful attempts to commit (4 in this case), it sends the message successfully')
